title: Angler's Challenge: The Big One
description: Finnigan's heard rumors about massive Groupers in these waters. He wants proof! Catch a Grouper weighing at least 100 pounds to show him it's not just fisherman's tales.
fishingTip: Big Groupers lurk in deep rocky areas. You'll need skill and patience to land one this size!

objectives.description: Catch 1 Grouper weighing at least 100 pounds.
